result.topic_en: Euler shows that successive convergents of a continued fraction differ by alternating terms ±1/(product of consecutive denominators), so the continued fraction equals an alternating series built only from the denominator ('German letter') recursion; he then announces the converse task of turning any series into a continued fraction.

items.english: and thus we have reduced the continued fraction to an infinite series of fractions, all of whose numerators are alternately +1 and −1.

items.english: This progression runs on to infinity if the continued fraction is extended to infinity; otherwise it will consist of a finite number of terms.
